policies.inbound:
@($"https://{(string)context.Variables["acr-login-server"]}/oauth2/exchange") POST
application/x-www-form-urlencoded
@($"grant_type=access_token&service={(string)context.Variables["acr-login-server"]}&access_token={(string)context.Variables["aad-token"]}")
<set-variable name="acr-refresh-token" value="@(((IResponse)context.Variables["acr-refresh-response"]).Body.As()["refresh_token"].ToString())" />
@($"https://{(string)context.Variables["acr-login-server"]}/oauth2/token") POST
application/x-www-form-urlencoded
@($"grant_type=refresh_token&service={(string)context.Variables["acr-login-server"]}&scope=repository:*:pull&refresh_token={(string)context.Variables["acr-refresh-token"]}")
<set-variable name="acr-access-token" value="@(((IResponse)context.Variables["acr-access-response"]).Body.As()["access_token"].ToString())" />
@("Bearer " + (string)context.Variables["acr-access-token"])
